summary: Iteration 10 - Tested the new CMS (auth + articles CRUD + Media Center). 11/12 backend tests PASS. CRITICAL: brute-force lockout returns 500 (datetime tz comparison bug) instead of 429. CRITICAL: Admin CMS New Article / Edit forms crash with 'react_dom_1.default.findDOMNode is not a function' due to react-quill 2.0 incompatibility with React 19 - admins CANNOT create or edit articles via the UI. Public Media Center page works correctly: dynamic loading, featured section, category filter, search, and article expansion all verified.

critical.issue: After 5 failed attempts, the 6th request returns HTTP 500 instead of 429. Backend log: `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes` at server.py line 173. Cause: `locked_until` retrieved from MongoDB is offset-naive while `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` is tz-aware. Lockout NEVER triggers, so the brute-force protection is effectively disabled. Fix: store/compare consistently, e.g. `locked_until.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before comparison, or store epoch seconds.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'New Article' (and presumably Edit) renders a runtime error overlay: 'react_dom_1.default.findDOMNode is not a function' thrown by ReactQuill.getEditingArea/instantiateEditor. react-quill@2.0.0 uses findDOMNode which was removed in React 19. The form does not render - title/category/body inputs all missing (input count = 0). Admins cannot create or edit articles. Fix options: (a) replace react-quill with `react-quill-new` (community React-19-compatible fork) and update import to `react-quill-new`, or (b) switch to TipTap / Slate, or (c) downgrade React to 18.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the ReactQuill crash above - cannot fill form, cannot submit, cannot verify list refresh.
Same ReactQuill crash will trigger because the edit form reuses the same editor component (not directly re-tested due to overlay blocking, but root cause is identical).

rca of the issue: Issue 1 (brute-force 500): MongoDB BSON datetime is always stored UTC but READ back as offset-naive. The login() handler compares it against `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` (tz-aware). Python raises TypeError, FastAPI converts to 500. The bug is silently disabling the entire 5-attempt lockout. Reproduce: POST /api/auth/login 6+ times with the same fake email and wrong password. Mitigation: `locked_until = locked_until.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if locked_until and locked_until.tzinfo is None else locked_until` before the comparison. Issue 2 (CMS editor crash): React 19 removed `findDOMNode` from react-dom. react-quill 2.0 internally calls `ReactDOM.findDOMNode(this)` in componentDidMount. The community has published `react-quill-new` (drop-in replacement) which uses refs instead. Mitigation: `yarn remove react-quill && yarn add react-quill-new`, then change `import ReactQuill from 'react-quill'` to `import ReactQuill from 'react-quill-new'` in AdminDashboardPage.js.
